summary: Iteration #2 end-to-end test of Qlub LA Market Intelligence Dashboard (light-theme rewrite + new /api/outreach/generate). Backend: 9/9 pytest passing including the new outreach endpoint (subject+email+generated_at returned for Bestia with pain_points). Frontend: login screen with terminal boot + wrong-password error + correct-password app-shell, sidebar with all 5 nav items + logout + nav-pill-active, Overview (31K market-reach, 4 perf cards, la-density-map with 23 pins), ICP (6 attrs + persona + anti), Restaurant Expo (65 rows in TABLE, search 'Bestia' filters to 1, expo-total reflects filtered count, detail modal opens & closes, filter cards + export buttons present), Marketing Insights (3 sliders; moving insights-tables changed insights-recovery-goal $112,200→$179,520), Voice of Customer (sync-lock-chip toggles, voc-staged-banner appears ~20s after Gemini sync for Bestia, promote activates voc-generate-outreach-btn, outreach-modal renders subject+email+copy button, clicking outreach-copy-btn changes label to 'COPIED!'). ONE FUNCTIONAL BUG FOUND: navigator.clipboard.writeText() in VoiceOfCustomer.jsx copyEmail() lacks a .catch() — in iframe/preview context (and anywhere Clipboard API is blocked) it throws 'NotAllowedError: Write permission denied' as an unhandled promise rejection, which triggers the CRA runtime-error overlay and blocks ALL subsequent UI interactions (logout, nav clicks). UI state still updates to 'COPIED!' because setCopied runs synchronously, but the overlay is blocking.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() has no .catch(); rejects with 'NotAllowedError: Write permission denied' in iframe/preview context → unhandled promise rejection → CRA red error overlay blocks all subsequent clicks (logout nav, etc.). User sees 'Uncaught runtime errors' flash even though the button flips to 'COPIED!'.

critical_code_review_comments: Clipboard write is a permissioned async API — always wrap writeText calls in try/catch with a legacy fallback (hidden textarea + document.execCommand('copy')). Same pattern should be applied anywhere else we add copy-to-clipboard.

server.py is now 604 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider moving VoC logic, Outreach logic, and LA dataset into separate modules (e.g., voc.py, outreach.py, data_la.py) before adding more endpoints.

Outreach endpoint uses the same retry cascade as VoC (gemini-2.5-flash → flash-lite → flash-latest) but duplicates the retry code block. DRY: extract a shared _call_gemini helper that both endpoints use.
RestaurantExpo.jsx table row has onClick on <motion.tr> — works with Playwright force-click, but for keyboard a11y add role='button' + tabIndex=0 + onKeyDown Enter/Space.

rca of the issue:
Bug: Clipboard copy click fires CRA error overlay.
Reproduction: Login (qlub2026) → VoC → Execute Research on 'Bestia' (unlock first) → Promote → Generate Outreach → Copy Email.
Root cause: navigator.clipboard.writeText() in /app/frontend/src/pages/VoiceOfCustomer.jsx line 79 (function copyEmail, lines 77-82) returns a Promise. When the preview runs inside an iframe (Emergent preview, certain embed contexts) the browser denies Clipboard API write and rejects with NotAllowedError. No .catch() → unhandled rejection → CRA dev overlay appears. The overlay is a full-screen fixed element that intercepts all pointer events, so subsequent clicks (logout, nav) silently fail.
Mitigation: Change copyEmail to async and wrap writeText in try/catch with an execCommand('copy') fallback via a hidden textarea — see action_items for snippet. Optionally add a window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', ...) guard in index.js to harden against any other missed rejections.
